## About
Teloloapan Auto Repair is a family owned and operated shop on Rockwell in Chicago. Ruben Delgado and his family run the place, and we keep growing because of our dedication to service and integrity.
Emissions problems are our specialty. We scan for trouble codes, inspect the whole vehicle, and explain everything we do to your car. We work on cars, trucks and vans, domestic or foreign, and every job is inspected and tested before your car goes back to you.
If you're not on Rockwell, you're in the wrong place. Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating from 450 Google reviews.

## Services
- Emissions diagnostic and repair: We scan for emissions trouble codes, do a complete vehicle inspection, and fix what's causing the failure. The diagnostic is free when we do the repairs.
- Engine diagnostic and repair: Check engine light or something just feels off, we use current diagnostic equipment to find the problem.
- Free exhaust inspection: Bring it by and we'll look over your exhaust system at no charge.
- Custom exhaust: Want your car to sound and look the part, we build custom exhaust systems.
- A/C service: A/C work for both older and newer refrigerant systems.
- Suspension, rims and tires: Suspension upgrades and a large variety of rims and tires.
- Electrical and maintenance: Electrical repair and regular maintenance to keep your car on the road.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Most American and foreign vehicles, including Chevy, Ford, Toyota, Honda, Nissan and Lexus.

Q: Do you repair transmissions?
A: We don't do transmission repair directly, but we can help you figure out the problem and point you to a transmission specialist we trust.

Q: Is the emissions diagnostic free?
A: Yes, when we do the repairs.
